query.title: Query

tools.description: Return metadata and resources for one IBB dataset.

dataset_id.description: CKAN dataset ID or slug from istanbul_search_datasets.
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

tools.name: istanbul_get_resource_schema
tools.description: Return DataStore field schema for a resource.

tools.name: istanbul_query_resource
tools.description:
Query IBB CKAN DataStore records with guarded filters and limits.

    API reference: https://docs.ckan.org/en/latest/maintaining/datastore.html
    Uses datastore_search, not SQL; field names come from the resource schema.

resource_id.description: CKAN DataStore resource UUID from istanbul_get_dataset.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

filters.description: Exact-match column filters using field names from istanbul_get_resource_schema.
filters.title: Filters

tools.name: istanbul_nearby
tools.description:
Find city services by kind and coordinates, or parking/pharmacy by district.

    bbox and types apply only to city_feature (parking, metro_station,
    air_quality_station, public_transport_stop, wifi, ev_charging, taxi_stand,
    market). air_quality includes latest readings; city_feature has station
    locations only. Static layers return published locations, not live status.
    District lists have no distances. Pharmacy records include name, district, address, phone, map links,
    provenance and freshness; maps_search_url is address search, not a verified pin.
    Pharmacy duty-end times are not guaranteed. Card/social locations are static,
    not live operating status.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude (paired with lon; mutually exclusive with district/bbox).
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: WGS84 longitude (paired with lat; mutually exclusive with district/bbox).
lon.title: Lon

types.description: For kind='city_feature' only: subset of parking, metro_station, air_quality_station, public_transport_stop, wifi, ev_charging, taxi_stand, market.
types.title: Types

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters (max 5000; default 1000, or 2000 for istanbulkart/social_facility, 5000 for air_quality).
radius_m.title: Radius M

district.description: Istanbul district name (supported for kind='parking' or 'pharmacy' only, without coordinates).
district.title: District

bbox.description: Bounding box [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] for kind='city_feature' only.
bbox.title: Bbox

tools.name: istanbul_traffic_status
tools.description: Return Istanbul citywide traffic index.

tools.name: istanbul_water_status
tools.description:
Get ISKI active faults (district or fault_number) or dam occupancy.

    Dam filters apply only to dams; fault_number is exclusive with district.
    Nearby faults are provided by istanbul_nearby(kind="water_fault"). Results
    carry fallback freshness and approximate fault locations; no restoration guarantee.

kind.description: 'faults' for active ISKI water outages or 'dams' for dam occupancy.
kind.title: Kind

fault_number.description: Specific ISKI fault number (kind='faults' only, exclusive with district/limit).
fault_number.title: Fault Number

tools.name: istanbul_mobility_nearby
tools.description:
Summarize mobility near a static place reference or coordinates.

    district (all 39 Istanbul districts) is exclusive with place/coordinates and
    returns parking only, without distances. District-only place names do the same.
    For Acıbadem specify 'Acıbadem, Kadıköy' or 'Acıbadem, Üsküdar'. Not address geocoding.

place.description: Known Istanbul place anchor or district name (e.g. 'Taksim', 'Kadıköy Rıhtım', 'Acıbadem, Kadıköy').
place.title: Place

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters for point mode (default 1500, max 5000).
radius_m.title: Radius M

district.description: One of Istanbul's 39 districts (parking only, no distances; exclusive with place/lat/lon).
district.title: District

tools.name: istanbul_city_services_nearby
tools.description:
Summarize WiFi near a static reference point and district-level libraries/culture.

    district (all 39 Istanbul districts) is exclusive with place/coordinates;
    district-only place names also return district address lists, without WiFi or
    invented distances. Radius applies only to WiFi with a point. For Acıbadem,
    specify 'Acıbadem, Kadıköy' or 'Acıbadem, Üsküdar'. Not full address geocoding.

place.description: Known Istanbul place anchor or district name (not full street geocoding).
place.title: Place

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters for WiFi in point mode (default 1500, max 5000).
radius_m.title: Radius M

district.description: One of Istanbul's 39 districts (libraries/culture only, no WiFi/distances).
district.title: District

tools.name: istanbul_neighborhood_profile
tools.description: Return a joined neighborhood profile from social, building, and earthquake scenario records.

neighborhood.description: Optional neighborhood (mahalle) name within the district.
neighborhood.title: Neighborhood

limit.description: Max neighborhood profiles to return (default 20, max 100).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: istanbul_transit_line
tools.description:
Get IETT line info, ordered stops or planned main-terminal departures.

    limit applies only to departures. This is not live intermediate-stop ETA.
    Cross-operator service notices are provided by istanbul_transport_disruptions.

action.description: 'info' for line metadata, 'stops' for ordered stops, 'departures' for planned terminal times.
action.title: Action

limit.description: Max departure rows (action='departures' only, default 20, max 100).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: istanbul_transport_disruptions
tools.description: Return current official disruptions and service announcements across supported transport operators.

mode.description: Optional transport mode filter, e.g. bus, metro, tram, ferry, rail.
mode.title: Mode

operator.description: Optional operator filter: iett, metro_istanbul, sehir_hatlari, marmaray.
operator.title: Operator

line.description: Optional line code filter, e.g. 500T, M2, T1.
line.title: Line

tools.name: istanbul_metro_accessibility_status
tools.description: Return official Metro İstanbul equipment/total counts and current equipment fault details, optionally filtered by line, station, or equipment type. This is not an end-to-end accessibility guarantee.

line.description: Optional Metro Istanbul line filter, e.g. M2, M4, T1.
line.title: Line

equipment_type.description: Optional equipment category, e.g. elevator, escalator.
equipment_type.title: Equipment Type

limit.description: Max fault rows to return (default 20, max 100).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: istanbul_datastore_query
tools.description:
Run a bounded SELECT over records from one allowlisted CKAN resource.

    SQLite dialect: use table records and published column names. GROUP BY and
    aggregates are supported; no writes, arbitrary functions or application DB.
    A complete bounded capture is required, never partial counts. The server
    enforces an outer result limit (default 20, max 100) even if SQL omits LIMIT.
    Only resources configured in CKAN_SQL_ALLOWED_RESOURCE_IDS are available.
    Local query syntax and bounds: https://github.com/Batu1-1an/istanbulmcp/blob/main/docs/datastore-sql.md
    Source API: https://docs.ckan.org/en/latest/maintaining/datastore.html

sql.description: Single read-only SQLite SELECT statement over table `records` (no joins, subqueries, CTEs or writes).
sql.title: Sql

limit.description: Outer row limit enforced by server (default 20, max 100).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: istanbul_market_schedule
tools.description:
Return the published weekly İBB market schedule, optionally by district/day.

    day accepts Turkish/English weekdays, today/yesterday/tomorrow, or an ISO
    date. Results are a static weekly schedule, not proof a market is open today;
    coordinates are source points and maps_url is a map search link.

day.description: Optional Turkish/English weekday, today/yesterday/tomorrow, or ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).
day.title: Day

tools.name: istanbul_events_search
tools.description:
Search indexed Istanbul event sessions; verify candidates with istanbul_event_detail.

    Returns source-attributed event cards with ticket_url, about.text excerpts,
    price_quote, timing_kind (scheduled vs flexible_entry), participation_conditions
    and result_info diagnostics. Unknown prices are never free or verified within
    budget; Ticketmaster is catalogue-only and Biletinial list rows need detail
    verification. Read istanbul://guides/events for full pricing/timing semantics.

query.description: Title search text (empty = no text filter).
query.title: Query

category.description: Category or Turkish alias: concert, theatre, opera_ballet, standup, family, festival, exhibition, workshop, sport, seminar, other.
category.title: Category

date_from.description: Start date: YYYY-MM-DD, today or tomorrow (Europe/Istanbul, default today).
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: End date: YYYY-MM-DD, today or tomorrow (max 31-day span, default +7 days).
date_to.title: Date To

time_from.description: Earliest session start clock (HH:MM). Excludes date-only flexible tickets.
time_from.title: Time From

time_to.description: Latest session start clock (HH:MM). Excludes date-only flexible tickets.
time_to.title: Time To

lat.description: WGS84 latitude (must be paired with lon).
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: WGS84 longitude (must be paired with lat).
lon.title: Lon

radius_m.description: Straight-line search radius in meters (default 5000, max 20000).
radius_m.title: Radius M

free_only.description: Require observed zero price; unknown prices are excluded.
free_only.title: Free Only

max_price_try.description: Max observed TRY price (whole-party subtotal when party/party_size is set).
max_price_try.title: Max Price Try

include_unknown_prices.description: Include events without observed prices; set false for verified budgets only.
include_unknown_prices.title: Include Unknown Prices

child_age.description: Child age (0-17); requires a published matching family age range.
child_age.title: Child Age

include_sold_out.description: Include explicitly sold-out sessions for inspection.
include_sold_out.title: Include Sold Out

include_past.description: Include retained active sessions that already started.
include_past.title: Include Past

exclude_child_only.description: Exclude events with published upper age limit below 18.
exclude_child_only.title: Exclude Child Only

party_size.description: Group size (1-50) for observed party ticket subtotals.
party_size.title: Party Size

ticket_profile.description: Attendee ticket profile: general, adult, student, child, senior, or any.
ticket_profile.title: Ticket Profile

party.description: Mixed group counts by profile, e.g. {'adult': 2, 'child': 1}.
party.title: Party

budget_includes_fees.description: Require observed fee inclusion when evaluating max_price_try.
budget_includes_fees.title: Budget Includes Fees

tools.name: istanbul_event_detail
tools.description:
Inspect one event_id or performance_id for verified sessions, offers and rules.

    Refreshes Biletinial details with bounded caching; Ticketmaster details remain
    catalogue-only without live prices or stock. Preserves start_time_basis,
    source_time_conflict, admission_window, entry_date_restricted,
    participation_conditions and source descriptions (untrusted data). Read
    istanbul://guides/events for full semantics.

event_id.description: event_id or performance_id returned by istanbul_events_search (never a URL).
event_id.title: Event Id

party_size.description: Optional group size (1-50) to compute observed price_quote per session.
party_size.title: Party Size

ticket_profile.description: Attendee ticket profile: general, adult, student, child, senior, or any.
ticket_profile.title: Ticket Profile

party.description: Mixed group counts by profile, e.g. {'adult': 2, 'child': 1}.
party.title: Party

budget_includes_fees.description: Require observed fee inclusion in price_quote.
budget_includes_fees.title: Budget Includes Fees

tools.name: istanbul_events_plan
tools.description:
Build deterministic one-day event options with ICS and calendar links.

    Separates complete options, partial_options, unverified_budget and date-only
    flexible_entries (never placed in timed plans/calendars). Checks time gaps and
    published age compatibility, not travel feasibility or live ticket availability.
    Read istanbul://guides/events for full planning/fulfillment rules.

date.description: Plan date: YYYY-MM-DD, today or tomorrow (default today in Europe/Istanbul).
date.title: Date

district.description: District for candidate discovery when event_ids is omitted.
district.title: District

event_ids.description: 1-20 event_id or performance_id values from search/detail.
event_ids.title: Event Ids

max_price_try.description: Total observed party budget across all stops in TRY.
max_price_try.title: Max Price Try

min_gap_minutes.description: Minimum gap between sessions in minutes (0-240, default 30).
min_gap_minutes.title: Min Gap Minutes

max_events.description: Maximum stops per plan option (1-3, default 3).
max_events.title: Max Events

limit.description: Max plan options to return (1-5, default 3).
limit.title: Limit

child_age.description: Child age (0-17); restricts to family events with matching published age range.
child_age.title: Child Age

require_known_end.description: Exclude sessions without a known end time.
require_known_end.title: Require Known End

exclude_child_only.description: Exclude sessions whose published upper age limit is below 18.
exclude_child_only.title: Exclude Child Only

min_events.description: Required minimum stops per complete plan (1..max_events).
min_events.title: Min Events

required_categories.description: Categories that must each appear at least once in complete plans.
required_categories.title: Required Categories

party_size.description: Group size (1-50) priced across every stop.
party_size.title: Party Size

ticket_profile.description: Attendee ticket profile: general, adult, student, child, senior, or any.
ticket_profile.title: Ticket Profile

party.description: Mixed group counts by profile, e.g. {'adult': 2, 'child': 1}.
party.title: Party

budget_includes_fees.description: Keep unknown fee totals unverified against max_price_try.
budget_includes_fees.title: Budget Includes Fees

tools.name: istanbul_next_departures
tools.description:
Search GTFS stop names or return scheduled departures for selected stops.

    stop_query with limit discovers stop_id candidates by name (NOT departures);
    same-name stops stay separate so ask the user to select before querying stop_id.
    Departure times cover 24 hours from published GTFS timetables, never live ETA
    or delays. Outside-calendar dates are unavailable. See istanbul://guides/transit.

stop_id.description: GTFS stop_id from stop_query search (mutually exclusive with lat/lon/stop_query).
stop_id.title: Stop Id

lat.description: WGS84 latitude for nearby stop departures (paired with lon).
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: WGS84 longitude for nearby stop departures (paired with lat).
lon.title: Lon

line.description: Optional published route short name filter, e.g. 500T.
line.title: Line

at.description: ISO datetime with UTC offset (default now in Europe/Istanbul).
at.title: At

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters for coordinate mode (default 500, max 5000).
radius_m.title: Radius M

limit.description: Max stop candidates or departures to return (default 20, max 100).
limit.title: Limit

stop_query.description: Stop name search text (Turkish/ASCII); returns stop_id candidates only, NOT departures.
stop_query.title: Stop Query

tools.name: istanbul_gtfs_snapshot_status
tools.description:
Inspect local GTFS load age, calendar validity, row counts and skipped rows.

    No upstream request or refresh is made. A missing or warming snapshot is
    unavailable, not an empty timetable. Cache age is not feed publication age;
    a loaded snapshot does not prove live arrivals or transport service.
